title: Agent Workflow Pattern
content: A practical Agent workflow usually contains planning, context retrieval, generation, evaluation, and revision. Keeping these steps separate makes the system easier to test and improve.

title: Quality Evaluation Loop
content: A review loop should check whether the result answers the user request, cites available context, includes risks, and defines measurable outcomes. Failed checks should trigger a focused revision.

title: Operational Metrics
content: Useful automation metrics include task volume, average handling time, manual review reduction, pass rate, retry count, user satisfaction, and cost per completed task.

title: Portfolio Positioning
content: A portfolio Agent project should show clear architecture, deterministic tests, realistic tool boundaries, and a concise explanation of business impact.
